title: GTA 6 Miami Marketing Push Turns City Into Real-Life Vice City
description: Rockstar Games and Take-Two are launching a massive marketing campaign in Miami for GTA 6, turning the city into a real-life Vice City ahead of its November release.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Miami Marketing Push Turns City Into Real-Life Vice City

Vice City is real now. With an outrageous and highly visible marketing push behind it, Grand Theft Auto VI is clearly shaping up to be an absolute behemoth when it arrives next month.

According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, Rockstar Games and its parent company Take-Two are going all-out with an extensive marketing campaign that is gradually overtaking Miami, Florida. The campaign is effectively transforming parts of the real-world location into a living, breathing version of Vice City.

### The Road to November 19, 2026

The highly anticipated open-world action game is officially scheduled for release on 19th November, 2026. As this launch window approaches, the sheer scale of the current promotional efforts suggests that the publishers are sparing no expense to ensure the title dominates the entertainment landscape upon arrival.

While fans have spent years analyzing every trailer and detail released by Rockstar, seeing franchise-inspired vehicles and elements appear in the real-world streets of Miami takes the excitement to an entirely new level. Industry observers note that such ambitious real-world activations are indicative of a historic marketing rollout.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar Games' decision to bring Vice City into the real world through this Miami marketing push is a brilliant move. It builds unprecedented hype and reminds everyone why GTA 6 is the most anticipated entertainment launch of 2026.
